examples.question: How many State Highways are there?
What is the longest road?
examples.sql: SELECT TOP 1 RoadCode, RoadName, Length FROM [dbo].[RoadMaster] ORDER BY Length DESC

examples.question: Total length of state highways in km
Total road length in Ajmer zone
examples.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM([Length in kms]), 2) AS [TotalLengthKm] FROM [dbo].[nmVWZonewiseRoadLength] WHERE [Zone] = 'Ajmer'
examples.notes: Zone road lengths come from nmVWZonewiseRoadLength view, length is already in km

examples.question: Show road length by zone
examples.sql: SELECT [Zone], ROUND(SUM([Length in kms]), 2) AS [TotalLengthKm] FROM [dbo].[nmVWZonewiseRoadLength] GROUP BY [Zone] ORDER BY [TotalLengthKm] DESC
examples.notes: Group by Zone from nmVWZonewiseRoadLength view

examples.question: Road network by zone breakdown
examples.sql: SELECT [Zone], ROUND(SUM([MDR]), 2) AS [TotalMDR], ROUND(SUM([SH]), 2) AS [TotalSH], ROUND(SUM([ODR]), 2) AS [TotalODR], ROUND(SUM([VR]), 2) AS [TotalVR] FROM [dbo].[RdNtwZoneWisePivot] GROUP BY [Zone]
examples.notes: MDR, SH, ODR, VR by zone from RdNtwZoneWisePivot view

examples.question: BCI condition zone wise
examples.sql: SELECT [Zone], SUM([Good]) AS [GoodBridges], SUM([Fair]) AS [FairBridges], SUM([Poor]) AS [PoorBridges], SUM([Very Poor]) AS [VeryPoorBridges] FROM [dbo].[vwBisBCICondZoneWise] GROUP BY [Zone]
examples.notes: Bridge BCI condition by zone from vwBisBCICondZoneWise view

examples.question: Structures, bridges and culverts in each zone
examples.sql: SELECT [Zone], SUM([TotalCulverts]) AS [TotalCulverts], SUM([TotalBridges]) AS [TotalBridges] FROM [dbo].[vwBisBrdgCulvCnt] WHERE [surveyID] = '2025' GROUP BY [Zone] ORDER BY [Zone]
examples.notes: Culverts and bridges count by zone from vwBisBrdgCulvCnt view
